mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity, which typically boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 105, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals a tight labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 250) indicate a restrictive monetary policy, which compresses equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 thousand units indicate strong residential construction, which supports consumer confidence and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Combined strength in housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and retail sales (RSAFS > 500000) signals robust consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 500000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 151.5 million indicate strong job growth, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 151.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) reflects sustained manufacturing expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days (approximately one quarter).
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 105, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
